description: Use this after make_pose_view to follow the view: pass its job_id every 10-15 seconds until the status is done, missed or failed (a view usually takes 30-90 seconds). Done: the view's picture, now in the shared library for everyone, and the mention that asks for it; write "@<character> in @<pose_handle>.<view>" in generate_image or generate_video. Missed (two tries did not come out right) and failed cost nothing; a try that landed on another empty place is kept there for everyone, free, and its mention is given too. Free.
name: check_pose_view
title: Check Pose View
